path_assumption: Paths assume the UK edition (site/uk/) is served at the root of greenjobs.co.uk. The 22 Sep staging build serves it under /uk/<slug>/index.html on greenjobs-redesign.pages.dev; confirm the production path prefix and trailing-slash form before loading the list.
source_of_pages: execution/gtm_client_workflows/greenjobs_redesign/build_site.py (LANDING for the UK edition; TAXONOMY; landing_search_href)
note_no_per_sector_pages: The new build has no dedicated page per sector. Real UK landing pages: /ecology-jobs-uk/, /renewable-energy-jobs-uk/, /sustainability-jobs-uk/, /environmental-jobs-london/. All other sectors exist only as board filters: /jobs/?sector=<taxonomy name> (the same links the /sectors/ tiles use).

No waste page; 'Waste & circular economy' board filter.
